clips.title: The story
paras: At Kharanos during the Lunar Festival, Elder Goldwell welcomes travelers and offers a chance to honor the ancestors. He keeps this old tradition alive across the snowy dwarven lands.

Beside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, Elder Goldwell watches the busy trade path leading to Ironforge's gates. During the Lunar Festival, he welcomes weary travelers, adventurers, and locals. His presence carries the long memory of ancient days, when early mortals walked beneath Azeroth's stars.

In Dun Morogh's winter winds, a visit to Elder Goldwell offers a moment to reflect. He is relieved and glad that mortals still remember the ancient races and their deeds. He thanks all who pause their journeys to show respect, and gives a Coin of Ancestry as an emblem of his blessing.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. I bid you well, friend, and offer you this token...
